verdict: Hyperscaler capex confirmed $725B for 2026 (all raised, market sold raisers); memory whipsawed -7% to +22% Jul 29-30; AMD+ALAB earnings Aug 4 next catalyst; HBM correction thesis denied by SK Hynix CEO.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24-72h)

**Hyperscaler capex season (Jul 22-31) — all raised, market punished raisers.** Google: capex $195-205B (raised), stock -7.4%; CFO warned 2027 higher still. Meta: $125-145B raised (profits -14%), stock -10%. Microsoft: Azure AI ARR +123% YoY, stock +8% — only winner where AI revenue visibly covered spend. Amazon: Q2 capex $53.1B, FY2026 raised to $220B; AWS +28%. Combined four-hyperscaler total: **$725B (+77% YoY)** — above the baseline $600-700B range. FCF turning negative at MSFT and AMZN. **No guide-down anywhere.**

**Memory whipsaw Jul 29-30.** Jul 29: SNDK -7%, MU -6% on supply-glut fears. Jul 30: SNDK +22% to $1,239, WDC +18%, STX +16% snap-back. TrendForce Q3 print (Jul 9): server DRAM **+13-18% QoQ** — deceleration from Q2's +81% industry revenue surge, not a reversal. ADATA spot data: DRAM modules +20-30%, NAND +35-40% QoQ. RMBS: **+37% AH** on record Q2 EPS ($207.4M, +8% above consensus).

**AMD Helios shipping.** Advancing AI 2026 (Jul 22-23): 72x MI455X HBM4, 2.9 FP4 exaFLOPS, $5.25M/rack. Early adopters confirmed: Microsoft, OpenAI, Meta, Oracle. AMD reports **Aug 4** (±12.28% implied move); ALAB also reports Aug 4.

**HIVE BUZZ: $220M sovereign AI GPU contract (Jun 18).** 3-year deal with Bell AI Fabric for Cohere; 2,304 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 GPUs, Merritt BC, live late 2026/early 2027. Contracted ARR rises to ~$105M+.

**Optical volatility.** Jul 28: Corning Q3 guide slightly missed → GLW -16-20%, spread to COHR -5.7%, LITE -4.7%, CIEN -5.9%. Jul 31 partial recovery: COHR/AAOI +7%, LITE +5%. Stifel raised PTs on COHR, LITE, CIEN ahead of earnings.

**HBM correction thesis actively denied.** SK Hynix CEO (Jul 11): "2027 will be the worst-ever supply crunch; demand exceeds capacity past 2030." TrendForce (Jun 2): HBM contract prices to surge "multiples higher in 2027." Goldman Sachs is the lone outlier bear.

**Solar mixed.** FSLR Q2: 57% gross margin (record), EPS $3.92 (beat), full-year guidance held, +5% on Wells Fargo note. ENPH Q2: revenue -19.6% YoY, EPS matched. NXT reports **Aug 5**, ARRY **Aug 11**.

- HBM sold-out status confirmed; SK Hynix CEO directly refuted the "correction after 2026" thesis.
- $725B hyperscaler capex materially above baseline $600-700B; FCF turns negative — a new signal to watch.
- AMD Helios on schedule; validates baseline custom-ASIC/Helios H2-2026 assumption.
- Optical 1.6T pluggable year tracking; CPO still H2-2027+.

## Most Important Development

Hyperscaler Q2 earnings confirmed **$725B combined 2026 AI capex** — above baseline — but the market is now actively punishing raisers (Google -7%, Meta -10%), marking a sentiment inflection: ROI scrutiny is replacing FOMO. Microsoft's +8% (AI revenue covered spend) was the survival template. **AMD and ALAB reporting August 4** will be the next stress test. Memory fundamentals remain intact but the Jul 29-30 whipsaw shows how fast sentiment can flip on capacity-expansion headlines.
